Payload timing probes

Reward curves per setting

One pair of charts per setting of the table above, for exactly the runs the table shows: the training reward (the mean reward of each trainer batch) and the held-out evaluation reward, against the training step. The smoothing switch above each chart applies a centered moving average whose window the slider sets (in logged steps for the training reward; off by default for the evaluation reward, in evaluations when on); "expand" opens the chart in a floating window with the same controls. Click a legend entry to hide a curve, double-click to show it alone; drag to zoom, double-click the empty plot to reset.
